notes.title: 「Zoo Pickup Bundle Vol.2」 of Japanese Indie games just released!
notes.notes:
Hey Japanese Indie fans! We hope you enjoyed our first "Pickup Bundle" of some of our titles that we recommend.  Now we have another Pickup Bundle for you to enjoy.  Ninja Castle Escape is an action puzzle game where you have to be creative and use your ninjutsu skills to escape from a booby trapped castle.  Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire is our all time best selling title that features cute anime girl characters changing into sexy new clothes as you complete stages of classic Mahjong Solitaire.  

Enjoy the following two great picks from Zoo at a special discount price!
・Ninja Castle Escape
・Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire

If you already own of the games then you can "complete the set" and get the other one for 20% off.  If you haven't yet tried either then please consider checking out both games to take advantage of this amazing offer!

Double the saving and double the fun!  

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20740/]here for more details[/url].

notes.title: 「Zoo Pickup Bundle」with two great Japanese Indie games just released！
notes.notes:
Hey Japanese Indie fans!  We recently launched Rogue Explorer, an exciting roguelike hack and slash action game.  To help spread the word about this new title we've created a bundle with our all time best selling game Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire.

Enjoy the following two great picks from Zoo at a special discount price!
・Rogue Explorer
・Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire

If you already own Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire, then you can "complete the set" and Rogue Explorer is yours for 15% off!  If you just recently discovered about us from Rogue Explorer then please check out Delicious! another of our games that we think you'll enjoy.  If you haven't tried either yet then save now on both!

Double the saving and double the fun!  

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20531/]here for more details[/url].
